items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: Another thing you were telling us was that Earl Bostic, you say, got a lot of his stuff from you now.

ctx.x: Another thing you were telling us was that Earl Bostic, you say, got a lot of his stuff from you now.

Well, Earl Bostic was very fast on the saxophone. Very fast. Very good musician and everything. But the style he played on the record, that's the style that Thereto Poino used to play around here. Yeah. That's the style. Every time I heard Earl Bostic's record, I said that. That's right. Have you seen Pernell lately or? I saw him at the banquet we had. Oh, yeah.
Somebody else thought maybe told me that he's recovering a little bit now.
